description: Eight-step sequencer with three rows of control voltage and a row of triggers

params.text: Sets the rate of the internal clock, read out in beats per minute
Starts and stops playback; while stopped, clocks are ignored and the step position stays put
Sends the step position back to step 1
Sets how many of the eight steps play before the pattern returns to step 1
Sets the voltage the CV 1 output carries on that step
Sets the voltage the CV 2 output carries on that step
Sets the voltage the CV 3 output carries on that step
Turns the trigger for that step on or off, which the TRIG output plays
Scales the TEMPO input from 0% to 100%; at 100% each volt doubles the tempo
Scales the STEPS input from 0% to 100%
Advances the sequencer by one step each time it is pressed, as long as the sequencer is running

inputs.text: Moves the tempo by an amount set by the TEMPO attenuverter
A clock patched here advances the sequencer and the internal clock is ignored
A trigger sends the step position back to step 1
Moves the number of steps by an amount set by the STEPS attenuverter
A trigger starts or stops playback

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse when the sequencer reaches a step whose trigger is turned on
The voltage set by the CV 1 knob of the current step
The voltage set by the CV 2 knob of the current step
The voltage set by the CV 3 knob of the current step
10V while the sequencer is on that step, and 0V otherwise
The number of steps as a voltage, one volt for each step past the first, for driving a second sequencer whose own STEPS knob is set to 1
The clock the sequencer is running on, whether that is the internal clock or a patched one
A 1ms pulse each time playback starts or stops
A 1ms pulse when the pattern returns to step 1

menu: Clock passthrough — sends the incoming clock gate to the TRIG output on enabled steps, rather than a 1ms pulse; on the internal clock it gives a gate half the clock period long
Rotate left — moves all three rows of voltages and the row of triggers one step to the left, with step 1 wrapping round to the end
Rotate right — moves all three rows of voltages and the row of triggers one step to the right, with the last step wrapping round to step 1

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
